_comment: Anthropic LIST prices, USD per MTok, verified 2026-09-24 against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing. THE single source of truth: routing-report.py, langfuse-cost-snapshot.py and flywheel-report.py all read this file, and none carries its own table. cache_read = cache_read_mult x input (0.1x by default; a model entry's own cache_read_mult overrides it — Fable 5.1 is 0.025x, Opus 5.5 is 0.05x). 5-min cache_write = 1.25x input, 1-hour = 2.0x; only flywheel-report.py can split the two (transcripts carry the TTL breakdown, Langfuse usage_details does not). Personal traffic runs on the subscription, so these are a notional value / quota proxy, not cash — only work-* sessions are real per-token spend. Set valid_until on any promotional rate: the snapshot warns once the run date passes it, instead of silently pricing at a dead rate.

claude-sonnet-5._note: $2/$10 is the standing rate — confirmed by Anthropic by email 2026-08-14, and the pricing page now states it outright. No valid_until: the old 2026-08-31 intro expiry would fire a spurious warning.
